fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Each tick of <rt.absorb>Searing Blaze</> on a target <rt.warning>increases the damage it deals by 4%</> up to a maximum of <rt.warning>40% increased damage</> at <rt.bold>10 stacks</>.

All stacks are lost when <rt.absorb>Searing Blaze</> is removed from the target.
fields.newer:
Each stack of <rt.absorb>Searing Blaze</> on a target <rt.warning>increases the damage it deals by 4%</> up to a maximum of <rt.warning>40% increased damage</> at <rt.bold>10 stacks</>. Every tick on that target increases the stacks by <rt.bold>1</>.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Each tick of <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> has a chance to make your next <rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</> cast 3 <rt.absorb>Nettlebolts</> at once.

(2.0 PPM)
fields.newer:
Each tick of <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> has a chance to make your next <rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</> cast 3 <rt.absorb>Nettlebolts</> at once.

<rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</> has +20% increased critical strike chance.

(2.0 PPM)

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Conjure a <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> at your side that stores <rt.meikoability1>12% of all Flutterfly healing</> you do inside it.

Every 2 seconds, the <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> releases a pulse, healing all allies within 4000 radius for an amount equal to the healing it has stored. Lasts 16 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> spawns <rt.effect>3 Boomshrooms</> when it withers.
fields.newer:
Conjure a <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> at your side that stores <rt.meikoability1>{healStorage} of all Flutterfly healing</> you do inside it.

Every {period} seconds, the <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> releases a pulse, healing all allies within {radius} radius for an amount equal to the healing it has stored. Lasts {duration} seconds.

<rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> spawns <rt.effect>{numOfBooms} Boomshrooms</> when it withers.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Grants access to <rt.mana>Finishing Moves</>  based on <rt.mana>Combo Builders</> used:

<rt.meikoability2>Finisher Techniques can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.meikoability1>PALM TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability1>Double Palm Strike</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Grants <rt.bold>+20% Magic Damage reduction</> & <rt.bold>+5% Parry</> for 30 sec.
<rt.meikoability1>Spirited Vortex</>  (CORE ABILITY)
• Conjures a Vortex around you that provides <rt.bold>+15% Dodge</>, deals damage to nearby enemies over 30 seconds, and reduces their movement speed by 35% for 5 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>KICK TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability2>Rising Storm</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Stormfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Lashing Stormkicks by 100%.
<rt.meikoability2>Lashing Stormkick</> (POWER ABILITY)
• Deals damage to target and nearby enemies nearby. Heals you for 50% of the damage it deals.

<rt.meikoability3>FIST TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability3>Rising Earth</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Earthfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Earthfist Barrages by 100%.
<rt.meikoability3>Earthfist Barrage</> (POWER ABILITY)
• Pummels target enemy over 1 second and heals you for 50% of the damage it deals.
